scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @radar/api" "npm run dev -w @radar/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @radar/contracts && npm run build -w @radar/api && npm run build -w @radar/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @radar/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w @radar/contracts && npm run test -w @radar/api
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
